description: This file contains the AuthoritiesDAOImpl class, which implements data access operations for Authorities entities using Hibernate ORM within a Spring framework context. It primarily provides a method to list all Authorities objects from the database.

classes.name: AuthoritiesDAOImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AuthorityDAO interface for database operations related to Authorities entities, using Hibernate sessions.
